name: Tainted Letter
summary: At Northshire, Tainted Letter calls novice human warlocks away from the Abbey guards for instruction in the fel arts. Drusilla La Salle entrusts it to Marshal McBride, who delivers it to her recruits.

sections.title: A Discreet Summons
sections.body: Novice warlocks receive a letter from Marshal McBride after proving themselves against the kobold menace. While priests and paladins study openly in Northshire Abbey, warlocks must tread carefully. Drusilla La Salle's insignia marks the letter, which directs each fledgling spellcaster to her secluded post outside the abbey's main walls before taking on other duties.

sections.title: Temptation and Ambition
sections.body: Drusilla warns that warlocks walk a precarious path under the watchful eyes of Stormwind's guards, whom she calls 'pathetic mundanes.' Drawing power from the Twisting Nether and communing with demons always risk corruption. She counsels patience, prudence, and firm self-control when handling those dark energies, but says caution must not extinguish a warlock's ambition.

faq.answer: Drusilla La Salle writes and seals the letter from her post just outside Northshire Abbey. She asks Marshal McBride to deliver it when you return from clearing the nearby kobold camps.

faq.q: Why does Marshal McBride deliver a warlock letter?
aliases: does mcbride know what the letter is
faq.answer: Marshal McBride carries messages to promising recruits in the valley. He knows the letter bears Drusilla's seal and says it takes priority, while his main concern remains Northshire's defense and administration, not policing the defenders' magical practices.

faq.q: Where can I find Drusilla La Salle?
faq.answer: Drusilla La Salle waits outside Northshire Abbey's main entrance, near the outer walls and tents, away from the clerics inside.

faq.q: Why are warlocks allowed in Northshire Abbey?
aliases: is fel magic legal in northshire
faq.answer: Warlocks in Alliance territory face heavy suspicion and keep a low profile. Drusilla trains recruits outdoors in Northshire, away from the sanctuary, to avoid direct confrontation with the Holy Order of Northshire clerics and paladins.

faq.q: What lesson does Drusilla teach upon receiving the letter?
faq.answer: Drusilla warns that drawing on the Twisting Nether risks corruption for any practitioner without discipline. She urges self-control and prudence, while insisting fear of corruption must not crush a warlock's ambition.

faq.q: What comes after delivering the Tainted Letter?
faq.answer: Speaking with Drusilla completes the summons and makes her your trainer. She invites you to return as you grow more powerful to learn more of the warlock's ways.

angles.text: As a warlock, you receive formal instruction in Northshire while keeping out of the guards' judgment and learning to master dangerous nether magic.
As a human, you live in a culture that reveres the Holy Light and the Kirin Tor's disciplined arcane. Warlocks practice their summoning quietly on the fringes of settlements like Northshire.
